notes.title: Playtest and new unlockable abilities!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
This announcement is to let you know that we are seeking players to participate in our playtest and take the opportunity to talk about some features we are working on that will soon be implemented in our game. We are focusing on unlockable abilities that Slink will be able to acquire during the game to help him in his quest.

Check out these otherworldly unlockable tools:

Magnet:
A magnetic beam that, when activated, is used to pull coins within a short distance. This tool will help fill Slink's pockets faster. 

Wandering Hand:
To reach keys, unlock doors and traps, and grab treasures from a distance, with the touch of a button, Slink detaches Snatch, his demon gauntlet, and the player takes control of it as if it were a remote-controlled car. Several treasures and areas in the game will only be accessible after the player unlocks this power-up. 

Torch of Disillusion:
A supernatural flashlight that allows the player to find and materialize items and treasures that were once hidden beyond our reality. With a ghostly beam of light, Slink will use this power-up to solve puzzles and find answers.

Call us on discord and get your download code!

https://discord.gg/GJpSuxka
